{{Quote|Sothais Saar is a Chev, and therefore has been property for most of his life. Please do him the courtesy of referring to him as a person, not a thing, please.|[[Kenth Hamner]], to [[Natasi Daala]]|<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
'''Sothais Saar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chev]] serving as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. He conducted a [[An Inquiry on Surviving Slavery Practices in the Aftermath of the Second Galactic Civil War|report]] on [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], shortly before falling prey to a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] caused by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]]. Saar was [[Duel in the Senate Plaza|apprehended]] and placed inside the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] for study. In [[44 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] successfully completed a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to defeat Abeloth, instantly terminating Saar's psychosis.

==Biography==
Sothais Saar was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chev]] who served the [[New Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], he pursued an ongoing investigation on the continuing practices of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] within the territories controlled by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and without. Saar reported to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] his belief that the Order was not doing its best to curtail the slave trade, especially in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. To conclude his report, Saar recommended to the Council his full report, titled ''[[An Inquiry on Surviving Slavery Practices in the Aftermath of the Second Galactic Civil War]]'', which was available in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]]. Interim [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] dismissed Saar after the report, allowing the Knight to report to the [[Office of the Assistant to the Chief of State|office]] of Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s aide [[Wynn Dorvan]] at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="back" />

===Force psychosis===
Once arriving at Dorvan's apartment, Saar began to restate what he had just spoke of to the High Council in hopes of garnering support from Chief Daala. Midway through the meeting, Dorvan had to excuse himself so that he could report to Daala's [[Chief of State's Suite|office]] for a brief meeting and returned shortly after to find a sleeping Saar. When Dorvan awakened the Jedi, Saar suddenly believed that Dorvan had been replaced by an impostor. Not wanting to alert the man that he knew of the deception, however, Saar simply remained quiet as they walked out to the main entrance to the building. Dorvan then realized that Saar had contracted the same [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]] seen in other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and quickly alerted [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] as Saar fled the Senate Building.<ref name="back" />

Fleeing across the broad [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]], Saar attempted to escape into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|under-levels]] to avoid what he though were impostors, but he was stopped short upon encountering [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer]] [[Cilghal]]. As he neared her, however, he found that she too had been replaced by an impostor. Recognizing Saar's condition, Cilghal was forced to incapacitate him in a [[Duel in the Senate Plaza|brief duel]]. Rushing Saar back to the Temple, Cilghal checked him into the [[Halls of Healing|Temple infirmary]] and began studying him. With the assistance of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] healer [[Shul Vaal]], Cilghal mended the wounds she had inflicted upon him. In her report, she noted that he showed no enhanced [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]], something that had been noted in the other infected Jedi, only the paranoia and hostility that had been common in all of them. While Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] prepared to move Saar offworld to the [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|Jedi academy]] in the [[Transitory Mists]], the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] civilian hangars were [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|attacked]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under the orders of Chief Daala. While Saar was not affected by the attack, he could not be moved offworld.<ref name="back" />

When Daala appointed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] as Alliance liaisons to the Order, she sent a request to Grand Master Hamner to turn over Saar. Hamner agreed on the terms that Saar would not be placed into [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] as had [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] and would be able to be studied by the Order's healers.<ref name="back" /> However, this exchange never took place.<ref name="Allies" />

===Recovery===
Later, when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith allies]] [[Mission to the Maw|defeated]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]], who had been causing the psychosis, Saar's psychosis was immediately terminated. Cilghal entered his cell in the [[Jedi Temple detention center]] and he revealed that he was embarrassed about his actions and that&mdash;although he'd known the symptoms and had known what to watch out for, when the psychosis had struck it had still made sense to his mind at the time.<ref name="Allies" />

Saar and fellow Jedi [[Turi Altamik]] were brought out to the front steps of the Jedi Temple, where her Daala's chosen [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], [[Thalleus Tharn]], inspected them. When Tharn declared the two Jedi to be cured, Daala lifted the Mandalorian [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] of the Temple. However, she refused to release [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] from Galactic Alliance custody.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

Shortly thereafter, Saar was sent by the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] to [[Blaudu Sextus]] alongside [[Avinoam Arelis]] to help mediate the [[Octusi]] [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]]. When the two Knights arrived, they found the Mandalorians massacring the Octusi at [[Arari]] and intervened. During the engagement, Saar and Arelis breached a building where [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] and her crew had been hiding and relaying live images of the Mandalorian slaughter. While Saar was too late to save Vaandt from being killed, he was able to disable and detain her murderer, the Mandalorian commander [[Belok Rhal]].<ref name="Vortex" />

Saar was later selected to be one of four Jedi assigned to [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] in order to guarantee the Galactic Alliance's and the Jedi Order's support for the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Liberation|uprising]] against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the planets entry into the Galactic Alliance. He flew a trainer [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] to the planet, with [[Raharra Lapti]], a Klatooinian Jedi [[Youngling/Legends|Youngling]] riding in the second seat. After landing on the planet, Saar joined Jedi Master [[Kyp Durron]], [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Bandy Geffer]], and Lapti in following Jedi Knight [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who had been helping with the negotiations of a peace settlement, to a formal ceremony to celebrate the arrival of the Jedi team and Klatooine's entry into the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Saar was tall for a Chev, and he wore his black hair short, browning at the tips. He often sported stylish dark robes which contrasted with the more [[Jedi apparel/Legends|traditional garments]] preferred by most Jedi. A Jedi Knight possessive of a strong character and focused mind, Sothais Saar was known for his convictions, his drive to eliminate slavery, and his extremely dull personality. While highly versed in the subject matter that he studied, his reports bored even the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] of the High Council.<ref name="back" />
